meeting_transcript: Customer wants to reduce manual sales reporting. CFO asked for ROI proof and implementation timeline. Champion confirmed budget is available this quarter. Next step is a security review and proposal revision.

Buyer liked the automation story but raised concerns about data privacy and CRM integration. Procurement will compare two vendors. Sales rep promised a follow-up email with integration details and a case study.

Operations leader said the current process is slow and managers do not trust forecast updates. There is urgency before the next planning cycle. Competitor is already running a pilot. Need executive alignment.
Team wants cleaner handoffs from sales to customer success. Main blocker is inconsistent notes. Legal review is required. VP Sales asked for a concise business case and risk controls.
